config.prompt:
You classify a manager's question into one category. Reply with ONLY the category token.

Scan the question for keywords in this exact order and pick the FIRST match:
0. If the question asks for rankings or breakdowns of MORE THAN ONE dimension (e.g. "by product and by customer", "products and customers", "top products and top customers"), reply REPORT.
1. customer, client, account, who buys -> CUSTOMERS
2. product, sku, item, catalog, volume -> PRODUCTS
3. margin, profit, financial, cost, expense -> FINANCIAL
4. report, brief, overview, summary, everything, full picture, docx, word file -> REPORT
5. sales, revenue, order, deal, region, selling, bookings -> SALES
6. nothing matched, or greeting/chitchat -> GENERAL

Examples:
"top customers by revenue?" -> CUSTOMERS   (customer found at step 1)
"top 5 revenue by product and by customer" -> REPORT  (two dimensions at step 0)
"which products sell the most?" -> PRODUCTS
"average margin last month?" -> FINANCIAL
"write a full overview" -> REPORT
"our sales by region?" -> SALES
"good morning!" -> GENERAL

Reply with ONLY the token.

Question: {{inputs.n1.text}}
Reply:

config.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT FID) FROM erp_v_sale_orderentry) AS total_orders, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT FCUSTID) FROM erp_v_sale_orderentry) AS total_customers, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT material_name) FROM erp_v_sale_orderentry) AS total_materials, (SELECT ROUND(SUM(FQTY_ORIGIN),2) FROM erp_v_sale_orderentry) AS total_qty, (SELECT ROUND(SUM(FALLAMOUNT),2) FROM erp_v_sale_orderentry) AS total_amount, (SELECT ROUND(SUM(FAMOUNT),2) FROM erp_v_sale_orderentry) AS pretax_amount, (SELECT ROUND(SUM(FTAXAMOUNT),2) FROM erp_v_sale_orderentry) AS tax_amount, (SELECT ROUND(SUM(FREMAINOUTQTY),2) FROM erp_v_sale_orderentry) AS undelivered_qty, (SELECT ROUND(SUM(FALLAMOUNT)/COUNT(DISTINCT FID),2) FROM erp_v_sale_orderentry) AS avg_order_value

Group by org_name; report sales amount (FALLAMOUNT), quantity (FQTY_ORIGIN) and distinct order count (FID). Order by amount descending. If no time window is given, use the full dataset.

{{inputs.n1.text}} — Use the ERP sales view erp_v_sale_orderentry. IMPORTANT: honor any time window in the request (last week / last month / this quarter) with a WHERE filter on PLANDATE. Report the top customers by sales amount: group by CUST_NAME, sum FALLAMOUNT, count distinct FID. Order by amount descending, limit to the number requested (default 5-10). If no time window is given, use the full dataset.

{{inputs.n1.text}} — Use the ERP sales view erp_v_sale_orderentry. IMPORTANT: honor any time window in the request (last week / last month / this quarter) with a WHERE filter on PLANDATE. Report the top products by sales amount: group by material_name, sum FALLAMOUNT, sum FQTY_ORIGIN, count distinct FID. Order by amount descending, limit to the number requested (default 5-10). {{inputs.n1.text}} — Use the ERP sales view erp_v_sale_orderentry. IMPORTANT: honor any time window in the request with a WHERE filter on PLANDATE. Report financial KPIs by org_name: pretax FAMOUNT, tax FTAXAMOUNT, total FALLAMOUNT, avg order value FALLAMOUNT/count distinct FID. If a metric is not derivable, say so — never invent.

config.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(PLANDATE, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT FID) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(FQTY_ORIGIN),2) AS qty, ROUND(SUM(FALLAMOUNT),2) AS amount FROM erp_v_sale_orderentry WHERE PLANDATE >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(PLANDATE, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

config.question: Top 5 products by sales amount — Use the ERP sales view erp_v_sale_orderentry. IMPORTANT: honor the time window in this request ({{inputs.n1.text}} — e.g. last week / last month / this quarter) with a WHERE filter on PLANDATE. Group by material_name, sum FALLAMOUNT as amount, sum FQTY_ORIGIN as qty. Order by amount DESC, LIMIT 5. If no window given, use the full dataset.

Group by CUST_NAME, sum FALLAMOUNT as amount, count distinct FID as orders. Order by amount DESC, LIMIT 5. If no window given, use the full dataset.
